entries.title: How I cut my Claude Code bill to zero

entries.title: Train large AI models on cheap laptop GPUs with one simple command. #AI #MachineLearning #OpenSource
entries.summary: Soup is an open-source tool developed by solo founder Alpamys Makajan from Kazakhstan that enables users to fine-tune large language models (LLMs) directly on affordable laptop GPUs. Traditionally, fine-tuning LLMs required costly cloud GPU rentals, complex scripting, and extensive debugging, deterring many from customizing AI models.

entries.title: GeoLibre launches free browser GIS with 1000+ tools #GeoLibre #opensourcegis #geospatialanalysis
entries.summary: Qiu Shengwu developed GeoLibre, a free open-source GIS tool that runs entirely in your browser and offers features usually found in paid software like Quantum GIS and Google Earth Pro. Users can explore cities in 2D and 3D, view planetary and historical maps, and import custom data to create world maps from scratch.

entries.title: Turn a screenshot into a full cinematic video with Claude Code
entries.summary: video-shotcraft is a free open source skill for Claude Code and Codex with 5,130 GitHub stars that builds cinematic product demo videos using Remotion. It ships with 152 shot recipe cards, 209 browsable motion previews and a production-ready template, so you give it a screenshot, describe the shot you want, and it storyboards, animates and renders the whole thing as real code rather than generated footage, which keeps your interface text and logo pixel accurate.
